confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident; accommodation anchors are less certain because mining and business demand in Antofagasta can push hotel rates well above typical Chilean tourist-city levels. The FX observation came from a search summary citing the RBA exchange rates overview; the RBA page itself was not read directly, so verify the 2026-10-15 figure on rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the regional price level of mid-sized Chilean port and mining cities in northern Chile, which sit between Santiago and smaller regional towns. Accommodation is adjusted upward for mining and business-travel demand. Drinks use the local beer-to-cocktail and beer-to-wine relationship where direct knowledge is weak.
